dogecoin.text:
Happy March Madness #VeFam. If there were a Crypto Bracket, who do you have in the final 4? My picks:

$BTC
$ETH
$VET
And everyone’s favorite Cinderella team: $DOGE

#VeChain
@ubitquity_io @dogecoin @elonmusk It has some sort of value no doubt. It’s more a question of if that value should really be $70 billion

@jasonrockwood The only coins that have real mainstream recognition are $BTC and unfortunately $DOGE. I would say not even $ETH is truly mainstream yet. I had a friend tell me he was thinking of investing in “ethereal” the other day...

Shocked and disgusted that El Salvador chose $BTC over $DOGE.

Everyone on Twitter promised me that $DOGE was 100% destined to be the new global currency and replace #bitcoin completely.

I feel bamboozled. Absolutely hoodwinked.

#VeChain $VET #Doge

@VETdweller “Dude crypto is going to change the world. I just loaded up on $DOGE, $SHIB, and $FLOKI. To the moon 🚀 🚀 🌙 🌙 💎 💎 🙌 🙌 “

🤦‍♂️

Something something take your $DOGE to the $VET

Idk, I’m out of things to tweet about.

Happy Friday.
#VeChain
